Method of Attack: Custom ransomware strain used in targeted attacks
Scans Internet for computers with open RDP connections
Breaks into networks by brute-forcing RDP endpoints to spread
Encrypts files and displays ransom notes with varying extensions and messages
Impacted Systems: Unnamed ICS company in the US
Attack Vector: Brute-force attacks on open RDP connections
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin wallet address with 26 Bitcoin (~$300,000) linked to ransom payments
Ransom note message containing the word 'sorry'
Date of Discovery: December 26, 2017 (first known infection of this SamSam variant)
